svg.title: ZzFX sound designer (proposal)
svg.desc: The inspector of a ZzfxStream resource: Play and auto-play, waveform, preset buttons, Randomize, Mutate, copy/paste ZzFX line and export .wav above the generated parameter sliders; the FileSystem panel previews audio files with Play/Stop.
svg.text: Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. Every action is an icon button with a tooltip (editor convention).
